lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular blobs arranged in a semi-regular grid; a prominent horizontal row of approximately 5 large blobs is visible mid-flank, with smaller, denser clusters towards the anterior region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect the horizontal rows of blobs, creating distinct anchor nodes at each intersection point throughout the mid-lateral region.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two prominent horizontal ridges are visible; the primary ridge displays a sharp transition from high-luminance upper pixels to shadowed lower pixels, extending from the posterior gill area towards the caudal region.

other_distinctive_markers: The leading edge and upper surface of the pectoral fin exhibit a dense clustering of smaller, lower-intensity white blobs compared to the primary flank constellation.
